title: Dominic and the Protocol
author: Sable Ravensworth
blurb: Ulyana Thackeray, a starship navigator haunted by the backups sleeping in the hold, records the slow death of a colony everyone else forgot. Then an unfamiliar name shows up on the manifest of a ship that never flew — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must keep a lie alive that holds two fleets apart, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
